name: Annals of Internal Medicine — Ideas and Opinions
notes: Ideas and Opinions: a short essay for a general internal-medicine readership — no abstract, no keywords, no IMRaD sections. LIMITS: the 1000-word body cap and the 10-reference cap are author-confirmed from submitted rounds, not scraped from the published instructions for authors; the 1-figure value is observed from one accepted submission and may not be the formal ceiling. Verify against Annals' instructions before relying on figures_max. Ethics approval, informed consent and trial registration belong on the ICMJE disclosure form, which Annals publishes alongside the article, not in the manuscript — an editor will ask for their removal. Every study named by acronym needs a one-line description in the text, and every effect estimate needs its 95% CI.
